title: Lab 2D part 1 — Aurora Serverless v2 study stack
topic: Aurora Serverless v2 in private subnets, DB subnet groups, security group database access, RDS Data API schema init, writer vs reader endpoints, teardown cost
format: 15 timed scenario questions (~24 min, ~96 sec each). Reinforces night-16-aurora-lab.md and night-16-lab-aurora-setup scripts. Answer without peeking at night-16-quiz-answers.json first.
answerDistribution: A×4 B×4 C×4 D×3 — options shuffled so correct letter varies

questions.question: night-16-lab-aurora-setup places Aurora in Night 9 private subnets. A stats Lambda in the same VPC must connect on port 5432. Both use security groups. What ingress rule belongs on the Aurora security group?

options.A: TCP 5432 from 10.0.0.0/16 — entire VPC CIDR for simplicity
options.B: TCP 5432 from saa-study-gsa-lambda-stats-sg — source is the app security group
options.C: TCP 443 from lambda-stats-sg — PostgreSQL uses HTTPS like RDS Data API
options.D: No inbound rule — Aurora initiates connections to Lambda on 5432

questions.question: The lab creates saa-study-gsa-aurora-subnets spanning private-a and private-b. Why must the DB subnet group include subnets in at least two Availability Zones?

options.A: Aurora requires public subnets in two AZs for Internet Gateway routing
options.B: NAT Gateway must sit in the same subnet group as the writer instance
options.C: Aurora storage replication mandates two AZs for subnet group creation and HA placement
options.D: Lambda ENIs can only attach to subnets listed in the DB subnet group

questions.question: You deploy Aurora Serverless v2 with MinCapacity=0.5 and MaxCapacity=1 ACU for the study cluster. Overnight the database has no connections. What happens to billing?

options.A: Billing drops to zero ACU — Serverless v2 scales to zero like v1
options.B: Minimum 0.5 ACU still bills while the cluster and instance exist
options.C: Aurora stops the instance automatically and charges only snapshot storage
options.D: Only NAT Gateway cost applies because the DB is in a private subnet

questions.question: night-16-lab enables --enable-http-endpoint on the cluster so -InitSchema runs from your laptop without psql in the VPC. Which service executes the CREATE TABLE statements?

options.A: Amazon RDS Data API over HTTPS using the cluster ARN and Secrets Manager secret
options.B: AWS Systems Manager Session Manager tunneling psql through the NAT Gateway
options.C: Amazon API Gateway HTTP API proxying SQL to the Aurora writer endpoint
options.D: AWS CloudFormation custom resource Lambda with VPC attachment and psql binary

questions.question: The setup script sets --no-publicly-accessible on saa-study-gsa-aurora-instance. A developer tries to connect with psql from a home laptop using the writer endpoint. What is the expected result?

options.A: Connection succeeds if they have the master password from Secrets Manager
options.B: Connection succeeds when using the reader endpoint instead of the writer
options.C: Connection fails — the instance has no public IP; clients must be in the VPC path
options.D: Connection succeeds after adding 0.0.0.0/0 to the Aurora security group

questions.question: Night 17 Lambda will INSERT into resort_stats. Which Aurora endpoint should the stats uploader use for writes?

options.A: Cluster reader endpoint — load-balanced across Aurora replicas
options.B: Custom CNAME you create in Route 53 pointing at the instance IP
options.C: Cluster writer endpoint — all writes go to the primary instance
options.D: RDS Proxy endpoint only — writer endpoint rejects INSERT statements

questions.question: Master credentials for saa-study-gsa-aurora use --manage-master-user-password. Where does the setup script read the secret ARN for RDS Data API calls?

options.A: SSM Parameter Store String parameter written by the teardown script
options.B: MasterUserSecret.SecretArn on the DB cluster from describe-db-clusters
options.C: Lambda environment variable GSA_DB_PASSWORD exported in night-9-vpc-ids.json
options.D: IAM user access key embedded in night-16-aurora-result.json by default

questions.question: A teammate proposes placing Aurora in the Night 9 public subnets (public-a/public-b) to avoid NAT costs for patching. What is the best response for a production-style GSA stats database?

options.A: Correct — public subnets remove the need for security groups on the database
options.B: Correct — Aurora requires IGW routes for automated minor version patching
options.C: Use private subnets with NAT — databases stay non-public; apps reach them via SG rules
options.D: Use public subnets but disable the writer endpoint to block inbound SQL

questions.question: After night-16-lab-aurora-setup.ps1, describe-db-instances shows DBInstanceClass db.serverless. Where is the MinCapacity=0.5 / MaxCapacity=1 scaling configuration stored?

options.A: On the DB instance as a modify-db-instance --max-allocated-storage flag
options.B: On the Aurora cluster as ServerlessV2ScalingConfiguration
options.C: On the DB subnet group as a capacity attribute per subnet
options.D: On the lambda-stats-sg as a tag consumed by Aurora Auto Scaling

questions.question: You run night-16-lab-aurora-teardown.ps1 after the lab. Which resources does it intentionally leave running?

options.A: Aurora cluster and instance — teardown only removes security groups
options.B: Night 9 VPC, NAT Gateway, and Night 12–14 EventBridge/SQS/SNS resources
options.C: Only the resort_stats table — cluster is stopped but not deleted
options.D: DB subnet group and Secrets Manager secret for Night 17 reuse

questions.question: GSA stores wiki page-view counts in DynamoDB and monthly resort aggregates in Aurora resort_stats. A report needs SELECT with JOIN across resort rows. Which store fits?

options.A: DynamoDB — enable DAX and use PartiQL JOIN across partition keys
options.B: S3 Iceberg only — Aurora cannot query relational aggregates
options.C: Aurora PostgreSQL — relational schema and SQL JOINs on resort_stats
options.D: ElastiCache Redis — store JSON blobs keyed by resort_id for JOIN emulation

questions.question: The Iceland batch completion path uses Night 13 SQS. Night 16 adds Aurora. Where does resort_stats fit in the pipeline relative to SQS?

options.A: SQS messages are stored inside Aurora as BLOB columns in resort_stats
options.B: Aurora replaces SQS — the batch writes SQL rows instead of queue messages
options.C: Downstream stats uploader (after SQS) writes relational rows to Aurora
options.D: Aurora publishes completion events back to SQS via RDS Event Notifications

questions.question: A junior engineer adds 0.0.0.0/0 on TCP 5432 to saa-study-gsa-aurora-sg so they can psql from home. What is the exam-aligned fix?

options.A: Enable public accessibility on the instance — SG open to the world is then safe
options.B: Remove the rule — use VPC Lambda or RDS Data API; source SG reference only
options.C: Switch to Aurora MySQL — port 3306 does not need security group rules
options.D: Attach the Aurora SG to the Lambda function instead of the database

questions.question: night-16-lab creates saa-study-gsa-lambda-stats-sg with no inbound rules. Night 17 Lambda will attach to this SG in private subnets. Why is empty inbound acceptable?

options.A: Lambda in a VPC never receives inbound connections — only outbound to Aurora matters
options.B: Aurora opens return traffic automatically without security group state tracking
options.C: NAT Gateway security group mirrors all inbound to Lambda ENIs
options.D: Inbound rules are inherited from the Night 9 fargate security group

questions.question: You need a read-only BI dashboard querying resort_stats without adding write load to the primary. Aurora has one writer and no extra reader instances yet. What is the practical first step?

options.A: Point BI at the cluster reader endpoint — it load-balances when readers exist
options.B: Add an Aurora read replica instance, then use the reader endpoint for SELECT
options.C: Use DynamoDB streams to replicate resort_stats into a second Aurora cluster
options.D: Enable Aurora Backtrack on PostgreSQL to serve historical read queries
